desc:
Welcome to New Orleans!

Welcome to AHS: American Horror Story, a fan-made experience inspired by the iconic horror anthology series.

Explore New Orleans, play as your favorite AHS characters, discover your abilities, and experience everything the supernatural world has to offer. Whether you’re a witch, interested in the supernatural, or just looking to roleplay with friends, there’s plenty to explore.

FEATURES
✦ Play as iconic AHS characters
✦ Witchcraft and supernatural abilities
✦ Explore New Orleans
✦ Roleplay with other players
✦ Supernatural abilities and combat

NEXT IN-GAME CODE AT 1.5K LIKES!

Disclaimer: This is a fan-made experience inspired by American Horror Story. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Ryan Murphy, FX, HBO Max, Disney, or the official production team. All rights belong to their respective owners.
